summary: Slice A3 of 0.8.7 (price, her clock, deadlines, the ceiling and the switches) is built in the worktree, uncommitted, and saved as a patch that applies to a clean export of HEAD (af28e38). New: workbench/brain_clock.py (her clock: price = desk share + new tokens / read rate + answer tokens / write rate, from rolling medians per model key and kind with reads in three size bands, built once per process from the brain.turn/1 ledger and kept current by turns.ask's observe(); exact fractions and whole ms; the deadline helper (max(3 s, 2 x price + 1 s), capped by the kind); BUDGETS, the design's 4.3 table, and caps(kind) building each kind's turns.Caps; her line 'Asking the model: 2 s of about 3'; slow_why from the meters (memory tight, on battery, the processor busy) at three times the price; lates: two in a row narrow, three in a session raise her cost of asking to the measured median). grammars.py grown to one grammar per kind (goal, pick, bind, next_pick, order, read_line, marks, ask_lines, columns, frame; TALK none) over a small GBNF subset it can parse, match, list, sample and measure; free words are never free characters (your request's words, the page's words, her joining words; flagged lines are not in a page grammar); worst_tokens/fits give an upper token estimate and every builder shrinks its optional repetitions to fit the kind's cap or raises OverCap. slate_stream.turn: one turn streamed with progress events, closed at its deadline (reading included) or on Stop by shutting the socket, with the close and the delivery under one lock so no event is delivered after the close; slate_stream.complete also takes on_progress. local_brain.completion streams through it when given on_progress or cancelled. turns.py (backward-compatible additions, documented in its interface block): NOT_SENT RECEIPT_FIRST (a wording kind is never sent before request.receipt_on_screen()), OVER_CAP also for a grammar over the answer cap, the port's complete() takes cancelled, LocalPort always streams, TurnRequest.card(buttons) (the one question card, then None), .ceiling(), .now_asking; request_for does not look at the worker when every switch is off; set_switches and the operation brain.help.set (execute, with Undo) registered through turns.FIELDS/SCOPES/dispatch, so the Kernel and CLI blocks needed no edit. fake_worker: the HTTP stand-in streams SSE one event per token (token_ms apart) and counts closed streams; FakeWorker takes cancelled and gives one progress event per token. brain_qt.py: a 'What the model may do' page in the Brain room with the five switches in words, Undo, and a note line. Registry regenerated on the copy (record_registry --check PASSED, 794 operations served) and copied back. Smoke: 28 of 28 OK. Nothing was tested in the owner's sense, no model was loaded (only the 4B's vocabulary, by llama-tokenize under the model lock), and nothing ran on the ThinkPad.

workbench/slate_stream.py (turn(): streamed, progress events, closed at the deadline or on Stop; complete() gains on_progress)
workbench/local_brain.py (completion: keyword-only on_progress and cancelled route the turn through slate_stream.turn)

workbench/turns.py (RECEIPT_FIRST, grammar cap check, cancelled to the port, LocalPort streams, TurnRequest.card/ceiling/receipt_on_screen/now_asking, request_for with all switches off, set_switches and brain.help.set)
workbench/fake_worker.py (streamed SSE in FakeServer; FakeWorker takes cancelled, one progress event per token, enforce_grammar uses grammars.matches)
workbench/brain_qt.py (the switches page in the Brain room)
docs/GRAPHITE_0.1_REGISTRY.json (regenerated on the copy: brain.help.set added; check PASSED)

Final run: SUMMARY 28 of 28 OK, exit 0 (an earlier run gave 25 of 28: two of my own expected values were wrong and the 0.8.6 read differs only by its per-call correlation_id, which the check now sets aside).

Grammars against the 4B's vocabulary (llama-tokenize, vocabulary only, one batched call under the model lock): finite shapes listed whole, free-word shapes 250 random answers plus the longest. Real worst / cap: GOAL 3/6 (12 options: 5/6), PICK 1/4, BIND 3/6, NEXT 4/8, ORDER 1/4, READ 17/24, READ two full steps built at 48: 31/48, READ four steps 31/48, MARKS 96/140, ASK 40/48, COLUMNS 20/30, FRAME 67/90. Every builder's estimate fits its cap; the per-answer estimate was below the real count for 10 of 251 READ answers and 3 of the two-step ones (the grammar-level bound still held), never for the other kinds.
An unbounded grammar never fits; a shape whose smallest answer is over the cap raises OverCap; E0's picks/choice listings are unchanged; a word 'ws' in a literal is not taken for free whitespace.

Price: 50 + 100/30 s + 6/5 s = 4,584 ms on the stand-in rates; 3,150 ms after three observed turns (medians); a kind with no timings borrows the key's: 3,350 ms; another size band keeps its own rate: 16,650 ms.

Her line 'Asking the model: 2 s of about 3'; slow_why at three times the price gives 'Slow today: memory is tight; on battery.' and the others; two lates narrow, three raise her cost of asking from 2,000 to the measured 10,000 ms.
A question at its new-token cap is sent (prompt 123 tokens); one token over is NOT_SENT OVER_CAP with no worker call; a grammar over the answer cap is NOT_SENT OVER_CAP.

Stream fixture (20 words, a token every 120 ms, closed at 700 ms): closed at 723 ms after 5 progress events, 0 events after the close, the server saw the stream closed. Through ask() on the HTTP stand-in: TAKEN, body stream true, t_max_predict_ms 6000, her line 'Asking the model: 0 s of about 5' during the turn and '' after. Stop pressed 0.3 s in: FAILED, why STOPPED, the buttons (ASK_OWNER) stand.

Ceiling: four asks give TAKEN x3 then NOT_SENT CEILING_TURNS with the buttons; card() gives the buttons once, then None; 3 worker calls. Over 600 random scripted runs: at most 1 card, at most 3 turns sent, 0 runs over their time budget.
Receipt first: a FRAME turn before receipt_on_screen() is NOT_SENT RECEIPT_FIRST with no worker call and her plain words shown; after it, sent and TAKEN.

Switches through the Kernel: brain.help.set is execute scope; all off is stored; request_for gives no port with off reason SWITCH_OFF; requests.read gives byte-identical output with all off (correlation id aside); a kind with all off gives exactly its no-model value and fallback with no call and no record; Undo restores the exact previous switches; an unknown switch is refused; the Brain room module imports offscreen with its switches page.
decisions: The answer cap is held by an upper estimate (a digit one token, ASCII letters one per four, a non-ASCII letter two, other signs one, a single space joining a following letter or sign) summed over the grammar; the design says 'fuzzed against the tokenizer', which the smoke did, but at run time no tokenizer is called for the grammar. A model can still write an admitted answer in non-canonical tokens; such an answer stops at max_tokens with finish 'length' and ask() refuses it whole (E0, unchanged).

READ with column and value words on: under the design's 24-token cap a provably fitting grammar allows one step only (two full steps measured 31 tokens real worst). The builder keeps steps first, then quoted words, then value words; lane B can ask READ at 48 (the four-step cap) or turn the optional parts off for two steps. Flagged for the owner/lane B: the 24 cap holds typical two-step lines (22 measured) but not every admitted two-step line.
A grammar outside grammars.py's subset (multi-line rules, unknown constructs) makes ask() raise as a contract error, which enforces the one builder; an unbounded grammar is NOT_SENT OVER_CAP.

brain.help.set is registered through turns.FIELDS/SCOPES/dispatch (the E0 hook), so engineering_kernel.py and engineering_cli.py are untouched. No separate read operation was added: the Brain room reads turns.stored_switches directly. Undo swaps with the previous stored setting (a second Undo redoes).

The ceiling lives in TurnRequest (E0's take_card kept; card(buttons) and ceiling() added); placing the line and the card in her column is lane B's one_question.py and the merge-time edit to her column (7.1), not this slice.

Talk: the switch exists and is honoured by ask() for any TALK kind, but no TALK kind is registered yet and the existing local reply paths (Ask Stacy, run_reply) were not rewired, so with Talk off those paths are unchanged from 0.8.6.
0.8.6 S5 and S7 (brief.py, the GOAL socket) are not in this tree: nothing here plugs into them; GOAL's grammar builder and caps are ready for S7's move onto turns.ask.

Prompt reuse is A2's: LocalPort.kept() is still 0 here, so with reuse off every token is new and kinds whose brief exceeds their new-token cap (GOAL 300, ORDER 200, ASK 60) are NOT_SENT OVER_CAP until A2 lands. local_brain.completion's signature line and LocalPort.complete are touched by this slice; A2 likely touches the same lines (cache_prompt), so expect a small merge there.
not_done: No test files written and no test suite, tiers or window checks run (the owner's rule). No real model loaded.
The Brain room page was not rendered or clicked offscreen (only imported); the BrainTab needs a full host.
The 'one question' card itself, the late defaults (read by default, a change never) and NEXT's 'worth asking?' are lane B's (B2, B4); the clock gives them asking_cost_ms, narrow and measured_ms.
The mark line and fold under her card (model_marks_qt.py) are A4's; brain_clock.asking_now gives the line's text.
